kanto.flavorText: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA- engineering experiments.

original-johto.flavorText: Said to rest qui­ etly in an undiscovered cave, this POKéMON was created solely for battling.

hoenn.flavorText: A POKéMON that was created by genetic manipulation. However, even though the scientific power of humans made its body, they failed to give it a warm heart.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining MEW’s genes. It’s said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining MEW’s genes. It’s said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

updated-johto.flavorText: It usually remains motionless to conserve energy, so that it may unleash its full power in battle.

original-unova.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew’s genes. It’s said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

updated-unova.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew’s genes. It’s said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

kalos.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew’s genes. It’s said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Mewtwo is a Pokémon that was created by genetic manipulation. However, even though the scientific power of humans created this Pokémon’s body, they failed to endow Mewtwo with a compassionate heart.
